OCCUPATIONAL FITNESS PLATFORM · RETRIEVAL DEVELOPMENT

Exact prefix allocation on reviewed sources

Engineering reference-original coverage on observed development fixtures. Corpus criterion metadata shares the catalogue underlying reference labels; broader criterion coverage alone is not patient-specific relevance, predicate entailment or clinical accuracy.

88 original units · 77 fixed queries · 33 observed cases · 0 new model calls. The exact Top10 source inventory is retained; only which five originals enter the prefix can change.

Known six source-scope failures quarantined; remaining textual applicability and clinical review pending

What the criterion hypothesis does

The strict control preserves every prior Top5 original-source atom. The criterion hypothesis preserves prior Top5 typed criteria, then chooses five actual originals covering the largest number of corpus-defined criteria from the existing ten-source list. Ties prefer earlier prior ranks. This is exact evidence allocation, with no case-specific source promotion or label lookup. Background evidence can move out of the first five; additional criteria need applicability review.
